시편 30:1.content: A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of David. I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

시편 30:2.content: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

시편 30:3.content: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

시편 30:4.content: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

시편 30:5.content: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

시편 30:6.content: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

시편 30:7.content: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

시편 30:8.content: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.

시편 30:9.content: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

시편 30:10.content: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.

시편 30:11.content: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

시편 30:12.content: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
